SELECT talk_id, rcv_gid, name, datetime FROM (SELECT MAX(talk_id) as talk_id ,if(send_gid=#{rcvGid},rcv_gid,send_gid) as rcv_gid , if(send_gid=#{rcvGid},if(substr(rcv_gid,1,1)='S',(select shop_name from shop where shop_id=replace(rcv_gid,'S','')),(select c_name from com_info where i_num=replace(rcv_gid,'C',''))), if(substr(send_gid,1,1)='S',(select shop_name from shop where shop_id=replace(send_gid,'S','')),(select c_name from com_info where i_num=replace(send_gid,'C','')))) as name , datetime FROM gallery_talk WHERE send_gid= #{rcvGid} or rcv_gid=#{rcvGid} GROUP BY rcv_gid, send_gid ORDER BY (MAX(talk_id)) DESC) as TMP GROUP BY TMP.rcv_gid ORDER BY talk_id desc;
